key_points: Foundayo showed 57% lower predicted 10-year diabetes risk and superior weight loss vs Wegovy.
Foundayo also linked to 18% lower heart disease risk, 0.3% greater blood-sugar improvement vs semaglutide, and 53% lower cardiovascular death risk vs insulin.
Lilly exited collaboration with Foghorn, dragging Foghorn stock down; minor negative for partnership pipeline.
Novo's Ozempic demonstrated lower cardiovascular risk than Lilly's Mounjaro in a real‑world study, underscoring competitive pressure.
Analysts view Lilly as undervalued after a 437% run, suggesting upside if pipeline delivers.
